# Zcash Nukuku Gaƒuƒoƒowo

## Tl;DR

* Nukuku gaƒuƒoƒo ɖoa nukula geɖewo ƒe hash ɖusime eye wòma gaɖoɖowo ƒe fetu si wòdi ɖe nukula ɖesiaɖe ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ɖe eme.
* Gaƒuƒoƒo la ƒe akɔnta lɔlɔ̃viwo xɔ fetu suewo le ɣeyiɣi dɔdɔme. Nukula ɖeka si zãa hardware le eƒe aƒe me ate ŋu alala ƒe geɖewo hafi exɔ gaɖoɖe ɖeka.
* Gaƒuƒoƒowo to vovo le fetu ƒe mɔ, adzɔ kple fetu ƒe ɣaɣla me. Nudzɔdzɔ ɖesiaɖe si le afisia me la ɖo nyawo katã gbɔ.
* Private Payouts ɖe fia ne gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe ate ŋu aɖo gaɖoɖo ɖe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɣaɣla me.
* Kpɔ gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe ƒe nɔnɔme kple eƒe adzɔ si le fifia le eƒe ɖɔɖɔ dzi hafi wòtsɔ hardware ɖo eŋu.

## Nyatakakawo Ƒe Nyatakaka

### Nu ka nye Zcash Nukuku Gaƒuƒoƒo?

Zcash Nukuku gaƒuƒoƒowo nye dɔwɔƒewo siwo na nukula ɖekaɖeka ate ŋu ado woƒe ŋusẽ ƒe dɔwɔwɔ (hashrate ɖusime) ɖe ɖeka me. Ne woƒo nuwo katã ƒu, akɔnta la ƒe nyawo le gaɖoɖowo siwo le network me ŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe edzi, eye woxɔ fetu suewo siwo vaa edziedzi, esiawo me wòle be woalɔ̃ ɖe nukuku ɖekaɖekae ƒe ɣeyiɣi si dzi mɔ mekpɔna o la dzi o.

### Fetuwo Ƒe Mɔwɔwɔ

Nukula ɖesiaɖe ɖoa dɔwɔwɔ sue aɖewo siwo wòwu nu siwo woɖo ŋu la si woyɔna be shares ɖe gaƒuƒoƒo la. Gaƒuƒoƒo la sia shares la eye wòɖoa fetu le eƒe fetu ƒe mɔ nu. Nudzɔdzɔ siwo le afisia me zãa mɔ etɔ̃:

- **Share ɖesiaɖe ta fe (PPS):** Gaƒuƒoƒo la fe ga didiɖe ɖe share ɖesiaɖe si wòdzɔ, ne èɖe gaɖoɖe loo alo menye o. Gaƒuƒoƒo la xɔ luck ƒe risk, eye ta esia ta PPS ƒe adzɔwo dzɔna le edzi.
- **Share N mamlɛtɔwo ta fe (PPLNS):** Gaƒuƒoƒo la ɖoa fetu le gaɖoɖowo si wònya ɖeɖe ta, ma ɖe shares N siwo va emegbe ŋu. Fetuwo yina ɖe dzi eye wòdzena le gaƒuƒoƒo la ƒe luck nu, eye adzɔwo dzɔna le anyi.
- **Share ta fe kple gaɖoɖe ƒe adzɔ (PPS+):** Gaɖoɖe ƒe fetu la ɖona le PPS mɔ nu, eye transaction ƒe adzɔwo ma ɖe PPLNS mɔ nu.

### Zcash Gaƒuƒoƒowo siwo ƒe ŋgonu va yi

#### Slush Pool (Braiins Pool)

Braiins Pool menye Zcash nukuku mɔ si wozãna fifia o. Eƒe [gaƒuƒoƒo ƒe FAQ si le dɔ me](https://academy.braiins.com/braiins-pool/faqs/pool) gblɔna be Bitcoin ko nye sika si wozãna, eye yegblɔ be woƒe ɖoɖo aɖeke mele be woakpe altcoins o (wokpɔe le 12 November 2026).

## Afɔɖeɖe / Kpɔɖeŋu

Nukuku gaƒuƒoƒo zɔna abe asrafome si ƒoa nu le atsiaƒu me ene. Ha ɖeka si le kplɔ ɖeka kple asikɔ ɖeka la ƒoa atsiaƒu ƒe ʋu ɖeka le ƒe geɖewo me. Kplɔwo ƒe ha ɖoa asikɔwo ɖe atsiaƒu ƒe vɔ̃a blibo la, wòkplɔa ʋuwo va le ŋkeke ɖesiaɖe, eye wòma ʋu si wòƒo la le kplɔ ɖesiaɖe ƒe asikɔ si wòtsɔ ɖe tsi me nu.

Wò hashrate nye asikɔ la. Gaɖoɖe ƒe fetu nye ʋu la.

## Nu Siwo Wozãna Vɔ̃

- **Nukuku gaƒuƒoƒo kple gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla ƒe tsitsi.** Nukuku gaƒuƒoƒo nye dɔwɔƒe na nukula. [Gaƒuƒoƒo ɣaɣla](/using-zcash/shielded-pools) nye Zcash protocol ƒe akpa si dzra ga siwo le ɣaɣla me.
- **Gaƒuƒoƒo aɖe tia ɖe adzɔ ko ŋu.** Fetu ƒe mɔ trɔa alesi wòƒe ga ƒe ɖoɖo dzɔna. PPLNS gaƒuƒoƒo si adzɔ sue la ɖoa ga sue le ɣeyiɣi si luck mele eŋu o me.
- **Status notes ŋu tsɔtsɔ ɖe megbe.** Poolin ƒe dzɔgbevɔ̃ nyatakaka le eŋu, eye Former Zcash pools ƒe ŋɔŋlɔdzesi la ɖea gaƒuƒoƒowo siwo megakukuna o hã fia ZEC.
- **Gaɖoɖe ƒe gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi nuwo ƒe ʋuʋuɖi zã.** Le teƒe si Private Payouts gblɔna be ƐƐ la, na gaƒuƒoƒo la gaɖoƒe ƒe dzesi ɣaɣla.
- **ZEC lalam le NiceHash gbɔ.** NiceHash ɖoa nukula fetuwo le Bitcoin (BTC) me.
